chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from the one who mentioned it, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)
regarding the Words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'Indeed we see you to be of the doers of good' [12:36]
He said: He (Prophet Yusuf) used to make space for others in gatherings, lend to the needy, and assist the weak.

key_terms.الضَّعِيفَ: The weak — those vulnerable or disadvantaged in society
key_terms.الْمُحْسِنِينَ: The doers of good (muhsinun) — those who practice ihsan, excellence in worship and conduct toward others
key_terms.يَسْتَقْرِضُ لِلْمُحْتَاجِ: Borrowing/lending to the needy — acting as a financial intermediary for those who cannot obtain loans themselves
key_terms.يُوَسِّعُ الْمَجْلِسَ: Making space in the gathering — a gesture of hospitality and social consideration

ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'doers of good' (muhsinun) according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) interprets the Quranic description of Prophet Yusuf (Joseph) as a 'doer of good' (muhsin) in verse 12:36, explaining that his goodness was expressed through three practical social acts: making room for others in gatherings, providing financial assistance to those in need, and supporting the weak. This interpretation exemplifies the Shia exegetical tradition of grounding abstract Quranic virtues in concrete social behavior.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abu Umeyr, from the one who mentioned it,
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [12:36] we see you to be of the doers of good.
He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘He<sup>as</sup> (Prophet Yusuf<sup>as</sup>), used to make space (for others) in the gatherings, and lend to the needy, and assist the weak ones’.
en.sarwar: 3. Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from ibn abu ‘Umayr from those whom he has mentioned (in his book) from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
About the words of Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, ‘We believe you to be a righteous person,’ [12:36]
the Imam said, ‘He would make room for others in a gathering, lend money to the needy and assist the weak.’”
